Stage: Computational cost of the LinGraph pipeline stages for 1,152 haplotypes, excluding cohort merging.

[a] Sum of SLURM job run times (sacct ElapsedRaw), excluding queue waiting. For each haplotype, batch or single-run step, the latest completed job is counted; failed, cancelled, out-of-memory and timed-out attempts are excluded.
[b] Sum of run time x allocated CPUs.
[c] Sum of time between job submission and start.

[d] All 304 attempts of each batch's final round (20 batches), including failed attempts, whose completed partitions were retained. Counting only each batch's completed job gives 601.96 h (19262.69 core-h); the subtotal is then 641.915 h (19918.603 core-h).
[e] Excludes minset queue time, which was not measured.
Steps not run as SLURM jobs (assembly preparation and repeat masking; graph-build steps on the launching node) are not included. Values are sums of figures reported to 0.001 h (minset: 0.01 h).
